funds.name: Central Otago District Council grants
funds.summary: Central Otago District Council's funding grants page, with a community guide to its grants process and rounds run by the council and community boards.

funds.name: Queenstown Lakes District Council Community Fund
funds.summary: Annual fund for not-for-profit groups and charities delivering events, services and projects that strengthen community wellbeing in the Queenstown Lakes District. The 2026-27 pool was $208,000, with applications in April.

funds.name: Clutha District Council grants and funding
funds.summary: Clutha District Council's grants and funding page, which links to Creative Communities, the TLCC Community Fund and reimbursement of council costs and facility hire for community groups.

funds.name: Southland District Council Community Partnership Fund
funds.summary: Community Partnership Funds run by each Southland District community board area for local community projects; the council also runs a District Initiatives Fund.

funds.name: Gore District Council grants and funding
funds.summary: Gore District Council's grants and funding page, including Creative Communities and the Coster Fund.

funds.name: Invercargill Community Wellbeing Fund
funds.summary: Invercargill City Council's contestable fund for community organisations, allocated by its Community Wellbeing Fund Subcommittee.

funds.name: Lottery Equipment for People with a Disability
funds.summary: Funds disability-related equipment such as vehicles and modifications, wheelchairs, mobility scooters, communication aids and certified assist dogs for NZ citizens or residents with a permanent disability,. Grants are paid to suppliers and requests are considered in funding rounds.

funds.name: Community and Volunteering Capability Fund
funds.summary: DIA Crown fund that builds the capability of community and volunteering organisations, with priorities for sector leadership, volunteering, organisational capability (internships) and youth worker training. Some priorities have an annual round; the internship and youth worker training priorities are always open.

funds.name: Racing Safety Development Fund
funds.summary: Grants to racing clubs and codes for projects that improve the safety of racing participants and animals, such as track and facility safety upgrades. Two rounds a year (2026/27: July-September and February-March).

funds.name: Safer Communities Fund
funds.summary: DIA Crown fund for security measures and support for communities at risk of hate crimes or terrorism, such as faith and ethnic communities.

funds.name: Disarmament Education UN Implementation Fund
funds.summary: Small grants for projects that put the UN study on disarmament and non-proliferation education into practice in New Zealand.

funds.name: Peace and Disarmament Education Trust (PADET)
funds.summary: Grants and scholarships for peace and disarmament education and research projects in New Zealand.

funds.name: Chinese Poll Tax Heritage Trust
funds.summary: Funds projects that promote and preserve the history, language and culture of Chinese New Zealanders, especially those descended from poll tax payers. Two rounds a year (2026/27: August-September and February-March).

funds.name: Norman Kirk Memorial Trust
funds.summary: Grants to help people from low-income or disadvantaged backgrounds with education, training or leadership opportunities. One round a year (2026/27: August-September).

funds.name: Pacific Development and Conservation Trust
funds.summary: Funds projects that conserve the Pacific environment and natural and cultural heritage, or promote peaceful, sustainable development in the Pacific. Two rounds a year (2026/27: August-September and February-March).

funds.name: Viet Nam Veterans and their Families Trust
funds.summary: Grants to support the wellbeing of New Zealand Viet Nam veterans and their families, including their children and grandchildren. Applications are accepted all year and considered at about six closing dates a year.

funds.name: Winston Churchill Memorial Trust Fellowships
funds.summary: Fellowships that help New Zealanders travel overseas to study or research a topic and bring the knowledge back to benefit their community. One round a year (2026/27: 8 July-13 August).

funds.name: Te Māngai Pāho funding
funds.summary: Funds te reo Māori and tikanga Māori content and broadcasting, including iwi radio, television, digital and music content. Funding rounds run to an annual calendar.

funds.name: National Heritage Preservation Incentive Fund
funds.summary: Grants to help owners of privately owned heritage places on the New Zealand Heritage List carry out conservation work. Usually one round a year.

funds.name: Marsden Fund
funds.summary: Contestable fund for investigator-led fundamental research across the sciences, technology, social sciences and humanities, applied for through NZ research organisations. Annual round, starting with preliminary proposals.

funds.name: Catalyst Fund
funds.summary: Government-funded grants (Catalyst Seeding and Catalyst Leaders) supporting international science collaboration by New Zealand researchers. Calls open at set times.

funds.name: Rutherford Discovery Fellowships
funds.summary: Five-year fellowships for early- to mid-career researchers to build their research careers in New Zealand.

funds.name: New to R&D Grant
funds.funder: Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment
funds.summary: Co-funding for businesses starting out in research and development, to build R&D capability. Formerly run by Callaghan Innovation; now shown on business.govt.nz.

funds.name: R&D Experience Grant
funds.funder: Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment
funds.summary: Helps businesses employ tertiary students in R&D roles, such as over summer, giving students work experience. Formerly a Callaghan Innovation student grant.

funds.name: International Growth Fund
funds.summary: NZTE co-funding for established exporting businesses with projects to grow internationally. Access is usually through an NZTE customer manager.

funds.name: Tū Manawa Active Aotearoa
funds.summary: Sport NZ fund, run through regional sports trusts, for play, active recreation and sport projects for tamariki and rangatahi aged 5 to 18. Regional sports trusts set the application rounds.

funds.name: Primary Sector Growth Fund
funds.summary: MPI co-investment fund (which replaced Sustainable Food and Fibre Futures) for projects that grow the value of New Zealand food and fibre.

funds.name: HRC Ideas funding (Projects and Programmes)
funds.funder: Health Research Council of New Zealand
funds.summary: Health Research Council contestable funding for health research projects and programmes, applied for through research organisations in annual rounds.

funds.name: Community Capability Development Grants
funds.summary: Grants to build the capability and leadership of disabled people's organisations and the disability community.

funds.name: Food Secure Communities funding
funds.summary: MSD funding rounds for community food providers and food security initiatives.

funds.name: Te Tira Takutai Moana funding scheme
funds.summary: Crown funding to help iwi, hapū and whānau groups with the costs of seeking recognition of customary interests under the Marine and Coastal Area (Takutai Moana) Act.

funds.name: Ngāi Tahu Fund
funds.summary: Funds cultural projects that build Ngāi Tahu cultural knowledge, practice and leadership, from small projects up to $5,000 for registered members to medium and large projects for Ngāi Tahu-associated entities. Two rounds a year (January–March and July–September).

funds.name: Kā Pūtea Scholarships
funds.summary: Scholarships for registered Ngāi Tahu members in their second or later year of tertiary study, from up to $1,500 (undergraduate) to up to $10,000 (doctorate). The round usually runs February to April.

funds.name: Waikato-Tainui scholarships and grants
funds.summary: Grants and scholarships for registered Waikato-Tainui members and marae, covering tertiary study, kaumātua health costs, sport, driver licensing, business innovation, environmental (Taiao) projects and te reo and tikanga. Each grant has its own criteria and many are limited to once per financial year.

funds.name: Ngāti Whātua Ōrākei scholarships
funds.summary: Scholarships for registered Ngāti Whātua Ōrākei hapū members, including Māori-medium teaching scholarships of up to $10,000 a year and partner scholarships with tertiary providers and businesses. Each scholarship has its own opening dates.

funds.name: Ngā Oha grants
funds.summary: Grants for registered Ngāti Whātua Ōrākei members covering education from early childhood to tertiary, sports and swimming subsidies, tutoring and kaumātua health costs. Applications are made through the Oha Hub with annual closing dates.

funds.name: Toitū Ngāti Porou cultural and sports grants
funds.summary: Sponsorship and grants for Ngāti Porou individuals and groups taking part in cultural or sporting events at local to international level. Applications must arrive at least two weeks before the event; the page also lists tertiary grants and scholarships.

funds.name: Ngāti Awa tertiary grants and scholarships
funds.summary: Tertiary grants and one-year scholarships for registered Ngāti Awa members in their second or later year of full-time study, run with the Māori Education Trust. The 2026 round opened in February and closed at the end of May.

funds.name: Ngāti Toa grants and scholarships
funds.summary: Education and sports funding for registered Ngāti Toa members, including youth educational activity grants, tertiary grants and teaching scholarships (administered by the Māori Education Trust), and sports grants for individuals and Toa clubs.

funds.name: Tūwharetoa education grants and scholarships
funds.summary: Education grants for registered Ngāti Tūwharetoa members from early childhood to tertiary and special needs, plus tertiary and trade training scholarships. Grants open each February; 2026 grants are closed and reopen 1 February 2027.

funds.name: Te Tumu Paeroa grants and Sir Āpirana Ngata Memorial Scholarship
funds.summary: Grants set up by owners or trustees of Māori land administered by Te Tumu Paeroa, for kaumātua support and education costs, plus the Sir Āpirana Ngata Memorial Scholarship for Māori higher education.

funds.name: Māori Education Trust scholarships
funds.summary: Scholarships for Māori secondary (Years 9–13), undergraduate and postgraduate students, applied for through one portal. The trust also administers many iwi education grants.

funds.name: Te Rau Puawai bursary
funds.summary: Support for Massey University students studying towards qualifications for Māori mental health work, such as psychology, nursing and social work, with fee and travel contributions plus mentoring. Applications open 1 September and close 31 October each year.

funds.name: Māori health scholarships (Te Pitomata Grant)
funds.funder: Health New Zealand | Te Whatu Ora
funds.summary: Health New Zealand's Māori health scholarships page, including the Te Pitomata Grant for students of Māori descent studying for health and disability careers at undergraduate and postgraduate level.

funds.name: Poutama Investment Support
funds.summary: Grants, mentoring and advice for Māori businesses for investigation, growth and training, administered by Poutama Trust.

funds.name: Your West Support Fund
funds.summary: One-off grants of up to $20,000 for West Auckland community groups for projects, operating costs or equipment. Applications go through the Fluxx system in annual rounds.

funds.name: Wiri Licensing Trust community grants
funds.summary: Manukau-based licensing trust offering community event sponsorship and a Community Impact Fund of monthly donations up to $500 for local organisations; its trustees also recommend gaming grants made through Trillian Trust.

funds.name: Auckland Airport Community Trust grants
funds.summary: Grants of about $260,000 a year, distributed in October, to organisations promoting literacy and life skills in South Auckland communities affected by aircraft noise. It also helps households in financial hardship pay for noise mitigation.

funds.name: Central Lakes Trust grants
funds.summary: Project, programme, capability and operational grants for charitable organisations in Central Otago and Queenstown Lakes, plus an arts support scheme and first-year tertiary scholarships. Applications are made through an online portal.

funds.name: Auckland Medical Research Foundation grants
funds.summary: Project grants, fellowships, doctoral scholarships and travel grants for medical research led from a tertiary institution or health provider in greater Auckland or Northland.

funds.name: InternetNZ community grants
funds.summary: InternetNZ funds community-led work that advances digital equity and a safer, more positive internet in Aotearoa, through grants, events and initiatives for organisations and individuals.

funds.name: Keystone Trust study awards
funds.summary: Scholarships for school leavers and tertiary students heading for a career in property or construction: up to $5,500 a year towards fees plus mentoring, networking and paid work experience.

funds.name: MAS Foundation grants
funds.summary: Community Koha grants up to $50,000 and larger Partnership grants for community-led projects improving health and wellbeing equity, focused on whānau in a child's first 2,000 days. Priority to Māori- and Pasifika-led initiatives.

funds.name: Masterton Trust Lands Trust grants
funds.summary: Community grants up to $20,000 (Impact) and $5,000 (Grassroots), education grants, school event grants and scholarships for people and organisations in the Masterton district. Main round opens mid-May and closes 30 June.

funds.name: Michael and Suzanne Borrin Foundation grants
funds.summary: Funds projects that fit its vision (law, justice and legal research). Send a short idea statement by email first; full proposals are by invitation and considered at two committee meetings a year.

funds.name: Fletcher Trust Philanthropy for Education
funds.summary: The Fletcher Trust's education philanthropy page. Details of what it funds and how to apply were not confirmed.

funds.name: Universities New Zealand scholarships
funds.funder: Universities New Zealand - Te Pōkai Tara
funds.summary: Universities New Zealand administers a range of national undergraduate and postgraduate scholarships and awards, including the Rhodes Scholarship selection for New Zealand.

funds.name: Fulbright New Zealand awards for New Zealanders
funds.summary: Fulbright awards for New Zealand graduate students, academics, artists, professionals and teachers to study, research or teach in the United States.

funds.name: Prime Minister's Scholarships for Asia and Latin America
funds.summary: Government scholarships for New Zealanders to study, research or do internships in Asia or Latin America, as individuals or in group programmes.

funds.name: Ngārimu VC and 28th (Māori) Battalion Memorial Scholarships
funds.summary: Annual scholarships for Māori students in undergraduate, postgraduate and vocational study, run in memory of the 28th (Māori) Battalion.

funds.name: Rhodes Scholarship for New Zealand
funds.summary: Fully funded postgraduate study at the University of Oxford for young New Zealanders, with an annual application round.

funds.name: University of Auckland scholarships
funds.summary: Searchable list of University of Auckland scholarships and awards for undergraduate, postgraduate and international students.

funds.name: AUT scholarships and awards
funds.summary: AUT's hub for school-leaver, undergraduate, postgraduate and international scholarships and awards.

funds.name: University of Otago scholarships
funds.summary: University of Otago's scholarships hub for first-year, undergraduate and postgraduate students.

funds.name: Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington scholarships
funds.funder: Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington
funds.summary: Victoria University of Wellington's scholarships hub for school leavers, current, postgraduate and international students.

funds.name: University of Canterbury undergraduate scholarships
funds.summary: University of Canterbury scholarships for undergraduate students, including school-leaver and equity scholarships.

funds.name: Massey University scholarships
funds.summary: Scholarships for Massey University students, listed by the Massey University Foundation.

funds.name: Lincoln University scholarships
funds.summary: Lincoln University's scholarships for school leavers, undergraduate, postgraduate and Māori and Pasifika students.

funds.name: Sir Edmund Hillary Scholarship Programme
funds.summary: University of Waikato scholarship programme for students who combine academic study with high performance in sport or the creative and performing arts, with leadership development.

funds.name: KiwiNet PreSeed investment
funds.summary: PreSeed funding, delivered through KiwiNet with MBIE's PreSeed Accelerator Fund, to take research from universities and Crown research institutes toward commercial startups and licences.

funds.name: Creative HQ startup accelerators
funds.summary: Wellington-based accelerator and incubator programmes for startup founders, including sector programmes such as climate and fintech.

funds.name: NZGIF investment for investees
funds.summary: Crown-owned green investment bank offering commercial finance and investment to businesses and projects that cut emissions.

funds.name: Velocity entrepreneurship programme
funds.summary: Student-led University of Auckland entrepreneurship programme running the annual Velocity Ideas Challenge and other competitions with prize funding for early ventures.

funds.name: Te Rarawa tertiary education scholarships
funds.summary: Tertiary education scholarships for registered Te Rarawa members.

funds.name: Ngāti Kahungunu iwi scholarships
funds.summary: Scholarships for Ngāti Kahungunu whānau in study.

funds.name: Raukawa education grant
funds.summary: Education grants for registered Raukawa members.

funds.name: Te Atiawa (Taranaki) education grants
funds.funder: Te Kotahitanga o Te Atiawa Trust
funds.summary: Education grants for registered Te Atiawa (Taranaki) members.

funds.name: Ngāti Apa ki te Rā Tō grants and scholarships
funds.funder: Te Rūnanga o Ngāti Apa ki te Rā Tō
funds.summary: Grants and scholarships for registered Ngāti Apa ki te Rā Tō members.

funds.name: Cambridge Licensing Trust grants
funds.summary: Community grants from the Cambridge Licensing Trust for local groups.

funds.name: Mataura Licensing Trust scholarships
funds.summary: Scholarships for students from the Mataura Licensing Trust district around Gore.

funds.name: Tauola Business Fund
funds.summary: Funding to help Pacific businesses grow.

funds.name: Kāpiti Coast District Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Kāpiti Coast District Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: Porirua City Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Porirua City Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: Upper Hutt City Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Upper Hutt City Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: Hutt City Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Hutt City Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: Masterton District Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Masterton District Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: Carterton District Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Carterton District Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: South Wairarapa District Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from South Wairarapa District Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: Greater Wellington Regional Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Greater Wellington Regional Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: Napier City Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Napier City Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: Hawke's Bay Regional Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Hawke's Bay Regional Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: Horizons Regional Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from Horizons Regional Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.

funds.name: West Coast Regional Council community funding
funds.summary: Community grants and funding from West Coast Regional Council. Its website lists current schemes and how to apply.
